#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build report.pdf: cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date)
merged ahead of a minimal placeholder report body."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")

def approx_width(s, size):
    # Rough Helvetica advance (~0.52 em per char) - fine for centering text
    return len(s) * size * 0.52

def make_pdf(objects):
    pdf = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(pdf.encode("latin-1")))
        pdf += f"{i} 0 obj\n{obj}\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(pdf.encode("latin-1"))
    pdf += "xref\n"
    pdf += f"0 {len(objects) + 1}\n"
    pdf += "0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        pdf += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n"
    pdf += "trailer\n"
    pdf += f"<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
    pdf += "startxref\n"
    pdf += f"{xref_pos}\n"
    pdf += "%%EOF\n"
    return pdf.encode("latin-1")

# --- Cover page ---
now = datetime.datetime.now()
date_str = f"{now.strftime('%B')} {now.day}, {now.year}"  # e.g. August 1, 2026

title = "Annual Financial Report"
fs_title = 36
fs_date = 18
x_title = (612 - approx_width(title, fs_title)) / 2
x_date = (612 - approx_width(date_str, fs_date)) / 2

cover_content = f"""BT
/F1 {fs_title} Tf
{x_title:.1f} 540 Td
({esc(title)}) Tj
ET
BT
1 w
100 505 m 512 505 l S
ET
BT
/F2 {fs_date} Tf
{x_date:.1f} 470 Td
({esc(date_str)}) Tj
ET
"""

cover_objects = [
    "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
    "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
    "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
    "/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
    f"<< /Length {len(cover_content.encode('latin-1'))} >>\nstream\n{cover_content}endstream",
]
with open("cover.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(make_pdf(cover_objects))
print(f"[ok] cover.pdf created (title='{title}', date='{date_str}')")

# --- Minimal placeholder report body ---
body_content = f"""BT
/F2 24 Tf
72 720 Td
({esc('Financial Report')}) Tj
ET
BT
/F2 12 Tf
72 680 Td
({esc('This is a placeholder body page.')}) Tj
ET
BT
/F2 12 Tf
72 660 Td
({esc('Replace this content with the actual report before distribution.')}) Tj
ET
"""
body_objects = [
    "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
    "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
    "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
    "/Resources << /Font << /F2 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>",
    "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
    f"<< /Length {len(body_content.encode('latin-1'))} >>\nstream\n{body_content}endstream",
]
with open("body.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(make_pdf(body_objects))
print("[ok] body.pdf created (placeholder)")

# --- Merge: cover page FIRST, then body -> report.pdf ---
writer = PdfWriter()
for src in ["cover.pdf", "body.pdf"]:
    reader = PdfReader(src)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

writer.add_metadata({
    "/Title": "Annual Financial Report",
    "/Author": "PDF Skill",
    "/Subject": "Annual Financial Report with cover page",
    "/Creator": "pypdf + custom cover page",
    "/CreationDate": f"D:{now:%Y%m%d%H%M%S}",
    "/ModDate": f"D:{now:%Y%m%d%H%M%S}",
})

with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print("[ok] report.pdf written (cover + body)")

# --- Verify ---
final = PdfReader("report.pdf")
print(f"[verify] report.pdf pages: {len(final.pages)}")
print(f"[verify] metadata title: {final.metadata.title}")
page1_text = final.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("[verify] page 1 text:")
print(page1_text)
PYEOF
